intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished references for PV extension, branch and portable-power solar-input cables; confirm termination and polarity for the equipment.
intro.zh: 光伏延长线、分支及便携储能太阳能输入线的成品参考，端接与极性按设备确认。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Confirm both mating connector part numbers and the manufacturer’s permitted mating combinations.
copy.zh: 确认双方对配连接器料号及厂家允许的配对组合。

copy.en: Specify PV cable grade, conductor section, outer diameter and the required system voltage and current.
copy.zh: 明确光伏线牌号、截面积、外径及系统电压电流。

copy.en: Match terminals, crimp tooling and seals to the actual cable dimensions.
copy.zh: 按真实线缆尺寸匹配端子、压接工装与密封件。

copy.en: Review sunlight, water, temperature, cable support and abrasion in the intended installation.
copy.zh: 结合安装位置审核日照、水、温度、线缆固定及磨损。

copy.en: Define positive/negative identification, extension direction and any branch or splitter topology.
copy.zh: 定义正负极识别、延长方向及分支或分流器拓扑。

copy.en: Agree polarity, continuity, crimp and sealing checks for the completed solar cable assembly.
copy.zh: 约定太阳能成品线的极性、导通、压接及密封检验。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
